items.source: Send a message to the specified destination, converting the payload to a byte[] with the help of a MessageConverter.
items.translation: 向指定的目的地发送消息，借助 MessageConverter 将负载转换为 byte[]。

items.source: Uses of StompSession.Receiptable in org.springframework.messaging.simp.stomp
items.translation: `StompSession.Receiptable` 接口在 `org.springframework.messaging.simp.stomp` 包中的使用情况

items.source: An overloaded version of StompSession.acknowledge(String, boolean) with full StompHeaders instead of just a messageId.
items.translation: 带有完整 StompHeaders 而不是仅 messageId 的 StompSession.acknowledge(String, boolean) 的重载版本。

items.source: An overloaded version of StompSession.send(String, Object) with full StompHeaders instead of just a destination.
items.translation: 带有完整 StompHeaders 而不是仅目的地的 StompSession.send(String, Object) 的重载版本。

items.source: Alternative to StompSession.Subscription.unsubscribe() with additional custom headers to send to the server.
items.translation: 替代带有额外自定义标头以发送给服务器的StompSession.Subscription.unsubscribe()。

items.source: Generic support for simple messaging protocols (like STOMP).
items.translation: 支持简单消息协议（如 STOMP）的通用功能。

items.source: A handle to use to unsubscribe or to track a receipt.
items.translation: 用于取消订阅或跟踪收据的句柄。

items.source:
Send an acknowledgement whether a message was consumed or not resulting
in an ACK or NACK frame respectively.
items.translation: 发送一个确认消息是否被消费的消息，分别导致 ACK 或 NACK 帧。

items.source: Remove the subscription by sending an UNSUBSCRIBE frame.
items.translation: 通过发送一个 UNSUBSCRIBE 帧来取消订阅。
